test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

There is many ways / to make / a stranger feel / welcome in the community.
solution:
The erroneous part is **'There is many ways'**.

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• There is an error in the use of the **linking verb **in the segment **'There is many ways'**.
 
• many ways *is a plural phrase and using the **singular linking verb **violates the **subject-verb agreement.**
 
• Thus, **option 2 **is the correct answer. 
 
• We can correct the erroneous part by using the **plural linking verb are. **

**Correct sentence__ - *****There are many ways **/ to make / a stranger feel / welcome in the community.*
